description: This file defines a sealed class 'DocEncoding' that extends the 'Encoding' class, implementing a custom encoding for PDF Document Encoding based on WinAnsi encoding. It provides methods for encoding characters into bytes, with some methods not fully implemented, and includes a static map for converting WinAnsi to PDF DocEncoding characters.

classes.name: DocEncoding
classes.description: A sealed class providing custom PDF DocEncoding based on WinAnsi, extending the .NET 'Encoding' class.

methods.name: GetByteCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes produced by encoding a set of characters.

methods.name: GetBytes
methods.description: Encodes a set of characters into a sequence of bytes, converting via a predefined mapping.

methods.name: GetCharCount
methods.description: Returns the number of characters that will result from decoding a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: GetChars
methods.description: Decoding method not implemented; throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: GetMaxByteCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bytes needed to encode a given number of characters.

methods.name: GetMaxCharCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of characters produced by decoding a given number of bytes.
